blocks.text:
## From the highlands to the Pacific Ocean

After arriving in Guatemala City, the journey takes you to the market in Chichicastenango and Lake Atitlán. You will learn about growing corn alongside local women, cross the lake by boat and visit San Juan and Santiago Atitlán. You will then see Iximché and colonial Antigua.

There is a free day in Antigua: you can explore the city or choose an optional trip to Pacaya or Tikal. The final two nights are spent beside the Pacific Ocean, on Monterrico’s dark volcanic-sand beach.

## Price and departures

Programme price: **USD 2085**. Departures on Saturdays in 2027. The programme is not available **20–28 March 2027** or **15 December 2027 to 4 January 2028**.

The room type and per-person price calculation are confirmed upon booking: separate SGL/DBL/TPL rates are not specified in the programme. Service languages: Spanish, English and Italian.
